From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
2018 racing video game
"Crew 2" redirects here. For the April 2021 SpaceX mission, see SpaceX Crew-2 . For the American soccer team, see Columbus Crew 2 .
2018 video game The Crew 2 Original cover art featuring the Zivko Edge 540 (top), the Jaguar Vector V-40R Powerboat (upper left), the KTM 450 EXC (lower left), the 2017 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 (center), the 2017 Harley-Davidson Iron 883 (lower right), and the fictitious Proto Buggy (upper right), featuring backdrops of the Golden Gate Bridge , Grand Canyon and Statue of Liberty Developer(s) Ubisoft Ivory Tower [ a ] Publisher(s) Ubisoft Director(s) Stéphane Beley Producer(s) Olivier Gueydon Yann Le Guyader Stéphane Jankowski Designer(s) Boris Mellet Programmer(s) Didier Blanche Artist(s) David Guillaume Composer(s) Steve Ouimette ill Factor Platform(s)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Crew_2.summary: The Crew 2 is a racing video game developed by Ubisoft Ivory Tower and published by Ubisoft. The game was released in 2018. The player can navigate the open world of the game through various vehicles including cars, motorcycles, boats and aircraft. Players are able to compete in races, complete challenges and explore the game's environment. The game features locations such as the Golden Gate Bridge, Grand Canyon and Statue of Liberty. The game has received positive reviews from critics and has won several awards. There is currently a sequel in development for the game.
